name: Lexiridge
subtitle: Academic words, band 6 to 8
shortDescription: IELTS and TOEFL vocabulary in two minutes a day: flashcards, four quiz types and a 3D word sky. Works offline, no account.
longDescription:
IELTS vocabulary and TOEFL vocabulary flashcards: learn 145 academic words with spaced repetition, four quiz types and a 3D word sky. Study for two minutes a day to build the academic English you need for reading, listening, writing and speaking. Works offline, no account.

### Learn
- Spaced-repetition flashcards with a card that flips in 3D, your own daily goal and a streak.
- Hear every word with your device's offline voices.
- 145 academic words in three "ridges", our own grouping for band 6, 7 and 8 targets (not an official list or score). Each word has a plain-English meaning, an example sentence, a common collocation and a synonym.
- Explanations and example translations in Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Hindi, Arabic and Simplified Chinese (machine-drafted and marked as such).

### Practise
- Quizzes in four styles: meaning, collocation, fill in the blank and synonym.
- Missed words come back for review automatically.
- A progress dashboard: last 7 days, mastery, quiz accuracy and best streak.

### See Your Progress
- Your words become a real-time 3D constellation. Brighter stars are stronger memories, each colour is a topic, and lines join the words you know. Tap a star to see the word.

### Works Anywhere
- No account, no sign-up, fully offline. iPhone and iPad layouts, A- and A+ text size on every screen.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
